stories.title: Geometry Primitives - Intersection Calculations
stories.description: Implement ray intersection functions: ray_circle_intersection, ray_rect_intersection, ray_line_intersection. Used by MouseClock and Concentric Box for target computation.
acceptanceCriteria: ray_circle_intersection finds where ray from origin intersects circle
ray_rect_intersection finds where ray intersects axis-aligned rectangle
ray_line_intersection finds where ray intersects line segment
All functions handle edge cases (no intersection, tangent, etc.)

stories.title: Color Management
stories.description: Implement centralized color registry and utilities: COLOR_REGISTRY dict, get_color, get_color_index, index_to_color, with_alpha, contrasting_color. Shared across all overlay systems.
acceptanceCriteria: COLOR_REGISTRY maps color names to 8-digit hex values (RGBA)
get_color looks up hex by name
get_color_index returns numeric index for ring/box ordering
index_to_color reverses index to color name
with_alpha modifies alpha channel of existing color
contrasting_color returns high-contrast color for labels

stories.title: Drawing Primitives - Basic Shapes
stories.description: Implement basic drawing functions: draw_line (with dashed option), draw_circle, draw_rect, draw_dot, draw_cross, draw_text. Used by all overlay systems.
acceptanceCriteria: draw_line renders line segment with color, thickness, optional dashing
draw_circle renders outline or filled circle
draw_rect renders outline or filled rectangle
draw_dot renders small filled circle marker
draw_cross renders + or x marker
draw_text renders text with configurable anchor point

stories.title: Drawing Primitives - Composite Shapes
stories.description: Implement composite drawing functions: draw_ray, draw_concentric_circles, draw_concentric_rects, draw_clock_rays. Build on basic shapes for common overlay patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: draw_ray renders ray from origin at angle with optional dashing
draw_concentric_circles renders multiple circles with different colors
draw_concentric_rects renders multiple rectangles with different colors
draw_clock_rays renders all 12 clock-hour directional rays

stories.title: Canvas Management
stories.description: Implement canvas lifecycle functions: create_overlay_canvas, clear_canvas, refresh_canvas, close_canvas, get_canvas_for_point. Wraps Talon canvas API for multi-monitor support.
acceptanceCriteria: create_overlay_canvas creates transparent overlay for a screen
clear_canvas removes all drawings
refresh_canvas triggers redraw (freeze)
close_canvas disposes resources
get_canvas_for_point finds canvas containing a point (multi-monitor)

stories.title: Mouse Control Primitives
stories.description: Implement mouse position functions: get_mouse_position, set_mouse_position, move_mouse_relative, get_screen_for_mouse, get_screen_rect. Thin wrapper over Talon ctrl module.
acceptanceCriteria: get_mouse_position returns current cursor (x, y)
set_mouse_position moves cursor to absolute position
move_mouse_relative moves cursor by offset
get_screen_for_mouse returns screen containing cursor
get_screen_rect returns bounds of a screen

stories.title: Position History Stack
stories.description: Implement position history functions: push_position, pop_position, peek_position, clear_history, get_origin. Used by MouseClock go_back and Spiral Nudge reset.
acceptanceCriteria: push_position adds position to history stack
pop_position removes and returns last position
peek_position views last position without removing
clear_history clears all stored positions
get_origin returns starting position for current session

stories.title: Debounce and Rate Limiting
stories.description: Implement input event throttling: debounce, throttle, is_cooling_down, reset_cooldown. Critical for sound-triggered actions to prevent runaway behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: debounce wraps callback to enforce minimum interval between calls
throttle limits call frequency to max rate per second
is_cooling_down checks if event type is in cooldown
reset_cooldown clears cooldown for an event type
Works correctly with Talon's event loop

stories.title: Sound-to-Action Mapping Registry
stories.description: Implement sound action registry: register_sound_action, unregister_sound_action, get_action_for_sound, set_sound_param. Enables configurable parrot sound bindings.
acceptanceCriteria: register_sound_action maps sound label to action with parameters
unregister_sound_action removes a mapping
get_action_for_sound looks up action for a sound
set_sound_param adjusts parameters for existing mapping
Supports multiple actions per sound (action chains)

stories.title: Overlay State Guards
stories.description: Implement state guard functions: is_overlay_active, any_overlay_active, get_active_overlay, require_overlay decorator. Ensures sound actions only fire when appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: is_overlay_active checks if specific overlay is showing
any_overlay_active checks if any mouse overlay is active
get_active_overlay returns name of current overlay
require_overlay decorator guards actions to only run with overlay active

stories.title: Screen and Window Utilities
stories.description: Implement screen/window functions: get_all_screens, get_primary_screen, get_active_window_rect, point_to_screen, clamp_to_screen, screen_center. Multi-monitor support.
acceptanceCriteria: get_all_screens lists all available screens
get_primary_screen returns main screen
get_active_window_rect returns focused window bounds
point_to_screen finds which screen contains a point
clamp_to_screen keeps point within screen bounds
screen_center returns center point of a screen

stories.title: Configuration Infrastructure
stories.description: Implement settings management: get_setting, set_setting, reset_setting, load_settings, save_settings. Centralized configuration for all systems.
acceptanceCriteria: get_setting retrieves a setting value with default fallback
set_setting updates a setting at runtime
reset_setting restores default value
load_settings reads from file
save_settings persists to file
Settings include: default_radius, radius_increment, debounce_interval_ms, etc.

stories.title: Logging Infrastructure
stories.description: Implement shared logging: log_debug, log_info, log_warning, log_separator, log_position, log_action, get_log_file. Consistent diagnostics across systems.
acceptanceCriteria: log_debug/info/warning write appropriate level entries
log_separator adds visual separator in logs
log_position logs coordinates with context label
log_action logs action invocation with parameters
get_log_file returns path to current log file
Log files are timestamped and rotated
